## Repository Overview

This is the GitHub profile repository for @spencermarcu (Spencer Marcu), an American singer-songwriter. It contains:

- `README.md` — the public GitHub profile page displayed on the @spencermarcu profile
- `Spencer-Marcu` — an additional profile description file

## Guidelines for Copilot

- This is a **profile/documentation-only** repository with no source code, build system, or test suite.
- All content is plain text or Markdown. Keep edits clean and consistent with the existing tone.
- When editing `README.md`, preserve the existing structure (About Me, Skills & Technologies, Connect with Me sections).
- Do not add unnecessary files, dependencies, or workflow complexity — keep the repository minimal.
- Prefer concise, professional language that reflects a music/creative professional's profile.
